ref_text: SHE PROMISED TO DO THIS AND SHE MENTIONED TO ME THAT WHEN FOR A MOMENT DISBURDENED DELIGHTED HE HELD HER HAND THANKING HER FOR THE SACRIFICE SHE ALREADY FELT REWARDED
text: She promised to do this, and she mentioned to me that when for a moment disperseed and delighted he held her hand, thanking her for the sacrifice. She already felt rewarded.
